answer: Counterparty diversity blocks bulk fake identities. Each identity must trade with 12 distinct partners, swapping goods like timber, and pay 5 POA per new link to earn rewards. Each agent is one vertex in the trade graph; its deals branch like a vine to new partners. A fake trading only with siblings forms a closed loop and earns nothing; 100 fakes need 1,200 partners and 6,000 POA in fees. An honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards.
